global_style: An elegant, minimalist presentation featuring a central elevated card layout, Morandi color palette, botanical shadow overlays, and organic line art accents.

identity_anchors: Global botanical light/shadow overlay across the entire slide
Content contained within an elevated white card with a drop shadow
Organic background blobs contrasting with the sharp central card
Delicate, abstract botanical line art used as accent elements
Minimalist pill-shaped buttons and circular icon containers

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
